parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

parameters.name: SourceType
parameters.description:
The service source. Valid values:

*   MSE: MSE Nacos instance
*   K8s: ACK cluster
*   VIP: fixed address
*   DNS: DNS domain

parameters.name: TlsSetting
parameters.description:
The Transport Layer Security (TLS) settings. Valid values:

*   mode: TLS mode
*   certId: certificate ID
*   caCertId: CA certificate ID
*   caCertContent: CA certificate public key
*   sni: service name identification

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse import-services --service-list '[{"GroupName":"test","ServicePort":8080,"SaeAppId":"example-string","ServiceProtocol":"GRPC,_HTTP","Ips":["127.0.XX.XX"],"DnsServerList":["1.1.1.1:80"],"Namespace":"public","Name":"test"}]' --source-type DNS --gateway-unique-id gw-77e1153db6e14c0a8b1fae20bcb89ca5 --tls-setting mode_:_MUTUAL_,_certId_:_100000-cn-hangzhou_,_caCertContent_:_123_,_sni_:_ceshi --fc-service-name guide --fc-version LATEST --fc-alias test-alias --source-id 100 --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
